title: feat(list): select a cell with a click, edit with a double-click, Enter or typing; no inline-edit toggle (#35684, #35687)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuBMEfPcpmd7H8s4hZUtCgst)_

Fixes #35684
Part of #35687

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: none — `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md` already teaches that inline editing is on by default for a user who may update the object, with `userActions: { editInline: false }` as the opt-out, which the list page now does with no toggle; no skill teaches the toggle or a single-click edit.

## 维护者速读

- 所有用列表组件（ListView）画出的表格都不再有"行内编辑"开关：对象列表页、界面列表页、对象数据页、Studio 数据区，以及页面里的列表块。单击只选中单元格（出现选中框），双击、回车或直接打字进入编辑，按空格或点名称打开记录；不能编辑的格子会说明原因，触屏轻点仍打开记录。
- 这是"列表行内编辑重做"系列的第一步，替列表用户解决单击就打开记录、编辑前要先开模式、中文输入法按回车被提前保存这三个问题。
- 碰到问题的是在列表里改数据的用户：最坏是某个格子进不了编辑或输入被误提交；修改仍先停在"全部保存"前、可"全部取消"，整个改动可以直接撤回。
- 页面里的列表块原来"点一行就打开详情或编辑面板"（例如示例 Task Desk、CRM 工作台），现在点其它格只选中，要点标题或按空格才打开。范围请在席位转来的决策卡上定：按现在的范围上、收回到只改对象列表页，或推广到相关列表、仪表盘表格等其余表格。合入前等你的答复。
- 拼音输入回车只在 Chrome 实测，Safari 没测，所以 #35687 合入后保持打开，只剩 Safari 这一项。

## What changes

**`data-table` gains a select-first cell model** (`@object-ui/components`), switched on by a new React context, `GridCellSelectionProvider`. A host mounts it; nothing authorable turns it on. With it:

- A click selects a cell (an outline ring, no layout shift) and neither edits nor opens the record. A link or button the cell draws keeps its own click (the name, a lookup, a phone, an email). A touch tap opens the record and never edits in place.
- Double-click, Enter or F2 edits with the value kept and the caret at its end. Typing replaces the value (a picker or a date opens instead). Backspace or Delete opens an empty editor and writes nothing.
- While editing: Enter commits and moves down; Tab and Shift+Tab commit and move right and left; Escape cancels and keeps the cell selected. In a multi-line editor Enter is a new line and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter commits. "Commit" is the grid's existing staged edit, saved by the row's Save and Save All as before. The save pipeline, the save bar, the row buttons and `defaultRowSave` are untouched (that is #35685), except that on every `ListView` grid the trailing row-button column is drawn only while a row has changes (see Acceptance notes).
- On the selected cell: arrows and Tab move the selection; Space opens the record (a two-state cell flips and commits instead, as a second click on it does); Ctrl/Cmd+C copies (CapsLock on or off); Ctrl/Cmd+V converts the text to the field's type and commits it; Escape clears the selection.
- An input method's composition stays whole. The selected cell's focus is an invisible input, so a composition lands in it. Keys pressed while composing (`isComposing`) never commit, cancel or move, and neither does the keyCode-229 Enter. The composed text opens the editor. This guard applies to every `data-table` editor.
- A cell that opens no editor says why, in a small notice on the cell.

**`ObjectGrid` gets a runtime host prop, `cellSelection`** (`@object-ui/plugin-grid`). When the host passes it, the grid mounts the provider and answers, per cell:

- Why the cell is read-only, in this order: the field (read-only, calculated, not editable in a list); the reader's field grant; the reader's object grant; the object's editability; the view's opt-out; the record's approval lock; the record-level verdict.
- What typing does there, whether the cell is a toggle, and how pasted text reads in a choice field.

`@object-ui/core` exports `resolveAffordanceGrant`, the grant half of `resolveAffordance` (which now calls it, with the same result). The cell's read-only reason reads the reader's object grant through it, so the reason order holds and every grant read goes through the affordance map (objectui#12082).

The approval lock is read per record from `GET /api/v1/approvals/records/:object/:id/lock`. The read is sent when a cell of that row is selected, never once per row on screen. The answer goes through `resolveApprovalLock`, the record page's rule, reused as is, with the row's `approval_status` standing in until it answers where the view fetches that column (see Acceptance notes, "Approval lock window"). A 501 is latched, and a failed read fails open: the server still refuses a locked write. The explain-engine verdicts also wait for the first selected cell, so the list keeps its lazy posture (objectui#34208).

**The list page (`ListView`, `@object-ui/plugin-list`)**

- No inline-edit mode, and no toggle on the toolbar or in Options → More. Its grid is editable wherever the permission gate admits the reader and the view does not declare `userActions.editInline: false`.
- A view's boolean `inlineEdit` still folds into that switch.
- It passes `cellSelection` to every `object-grid` view it draws, on every host (below).
- Every view of an editable list now carries the concurrency token `updated_at`, so switching between the grid and another view re-reads nothing (objectui#7394).
- `ListViewProps.onInlineEditChange` is deprecated and never called.

**Console (`@object-ui/app-shell`)**

- The session-mode plumbing is gone (`keepInlineEditModeForTheSession` and the `onInlineEditChange` relay).
- The interface page writes the canonical `userActions.editInline` instead of the legacy `inlineEdit` its relay census refused.

**Locale packs (`@object-ui/i18n`, all 11)**

- New: `table.cellReadOnly` and `grid.readOnlyReason.*` (nine reasons).
- No key is removed. `list.inlineEditLabel` (read by nothing now) and `list.inlineEditShort` (read only by `ViewSettingsPopover`'s dead row) stay as on main. Their retirement card, #35749, was closed as not planned by triage (nothing a user sees changes), so both stay.

**Docs and checklist**

- `plugin-grid.mdx` § Inline Editing gains "On an object's list page".
- `plugin-view.mdx` drops the toggle.
- `ux-conventions.write-feedback` is reworded, at revision 14.

**Which grids select first.** `ListView` passes `cellSelection` to each `object-grid` view it draws (`ListView.tsx:8129-8134`, the only producer), and `ObjectGrid` is the only place the provider is mounted. So every grid a `ListView` draws has the model: the console's object list pages, interface list pages, the object data page (`/apps/:app/:object/data`), the Studio Data pillar's records artboard (through plugin-view `ObjectView`'s `renderListView` slot), and every `list-view` block, whether an SDUI page node or a `ListView` on a `kind: 'react'` page (the showcase Task Desk, CRM workbench and renewals pipeline among them). A grid no `ListView` draws mounts no provider and keeps its click-to-edit (`singleClickEdit`) and click-to-open: an authored `object-grid` node, plugin-view `ObjectView`'s own grid (the `object-view` block, or a host that passes no `renderListView`), a related list, a dashboard table, the record picker and the designer's grids. `packages/spec` is untouched.

**Known, intentional gap: the spec's `singleClickEdit` prose.** It says "Enter cell edit on single click (default true when editable)" (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`). That stays true for every grid no `ListView` draws. On a `ListView` grid it is not true any more: a click there selects and never edits. The gap is left open on purpose until the rollout decision (list page only, or every grid) is ruled. The rollout card then brings the prose and the hosts together.

### Read first (by risk)

1. `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx` — `selectCell`, `attemptEdit`, `handleSelectFirstKeyDown`, the `cell-type-catcher` input and the cell's `onMouseDown` / `onDoubleClick` / `onClick` branches.
2. `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` — `gridCellSelection` (`describeCell`, `onCellSelect`), with `objectGridCellFacts.ts` and `hooks/useRowApprovalLocks.ts`.
3. `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` — `inlineEditOffered` → the grid's `editable`, `rowsCarryConcurrencyToken`, and the `cellSelection` host prop.

### Two-minute verification

`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/components/src/__tests__/data-table-select-first-35684.test.tsx packages/components/src/__tests__/data-table-keys-35687.test.tsx packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.cellSelection-35684.test.tsx` should pass 3 files and 38 tests.

Or click through by hand: open any object list in the console and click a plain cell. A ring appears and nothing opens. Double-click it and the editor opens with the caret after the value; Escape puts the value back.

## Tests

New (48 tests):

- `components/src/__tests__/data-table-select-first-35684.test.tsx` (17): click selects (with a no-provider control), double-click / Enter / F2, a double-click over selected text, a re-click keeping focus, Space and two-state cells, links, read-only reasons, touch, and the edit column drawn only while a row has changes (with a no-provider control).
- `components/src/__tests__/data-table-keys-35687.test.tsx` (14): arrows / Tab / Escape on the selection, typing, `5` then Esc, Backspace / Delete, paste, copy, Enter / Tab / Shift+Tab commit-and-move, multi-line Ctrl/Cmd+Enter, IME composition (`zhong` → 中), keys while composing, and with CapsLock on: Ctrl+C (key `C`) still copies, and Ctrl+V (key `V`) types nothing into the cell while the paste still commits.
- `plugin-grid/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.cellSelection-35684.test.tsx` (7): the relay and its control, each reason in its words, the lock read on select, the `approval_status` fallback, an unlocked answer overriding the column.
- `plugin-grid/src/objectGridCellFacts-35684.test.ts` (8): reason order, typing per type, pasted choices.
- `core/src/utils/__tests__/affordanceGrant-35684.test.ts` (2): the grant half answers apart from the object's API operations, and reads open with no object or no principal.

Migrated (they pinned the toggle, the mode or a click that opened the record):

- `ListView.permissions.test.tsx`: the #4647 toggle blocks, the `editInline` switch block and the objectui#5144 fold block (19 tests) are one 11-row `it.each` on the grid's `editable`, plus one test that no toggle is drawn on either toolbar (the compact case uses main's `openDisplayWithoutMore`). **Retired:** "the toggle reports to the host" (there is no toggle).
- `ListView.test.tsx`: "inline-edit toggle drives grid editability" (2) became "the grid is editable with no mode and no toggle" (3).
- `ListView.displayPopover-12423.test.tsx`: with Row numbers (gone in #35706) and Edit inline both gone, this list's Options menu draws no More level, and the test asserts that no Edit inline or Row numbers switch is on any level.
- `ListView.personalization-28950` (the live Display report now uses the row height), `ListView.restoreViewDefaults-28948` and `ListView.toolbarIconButtons-12695` (they clear the row colour), and the harness `displayMenuClose-12621` block (the Escape target is the Row height row; the control clears the row colour and picks a row height). #35706 had moved all four onto the Edit inline switch this PR removes.
- `ListViewBlock.specInputs-13047.test.tsx`: the `compactToolbar` test no longer uses the toggle. "`inlineEdit: true` renders editable" became the fold: absent → editable, `true` → editable, `false` → not.
- `ListView.harness.test.tsx`, concurrency-token block (objectui#12292): a view that declares nothing now asks for `updated_at`; the negative case is `userActions.editInline: false`.
- `ObjectView.inlineEditSessionOnly-5144.test.tsx` and `ObjectView.fallbackTabSessionOnly-11643.test.tsx`: the callback is asserted absent and the toggle calls are gone.
- `InterfaceListPage.editInlineFold-5144.test.tsx` and `InterfaceListPage.relayCensus-11572.test.ts`: the page writes `userActions.editInline`, and the census entry for the legacy `inlineEdit` is deleted. `InterfaceListPage.userActionsSpecDefaults.test.tsx`: the spec-default toolbar the page composes now includes `editInline: true`, which is `UserActionsConfigSchema`'s own default.
- `ObjectView.rowOpensNothing-33317.test.tsx` and `ObjectView.listOnlyRecordPage-33219.test.tsx`: the CONTROL cases open the record through the name link or Space on a selected cell. The negative cases add a Space probe, because a click on a data cell now opens nothing in any mode. The ⌘-click control asserts that the record link keeps the browser's default.
- Projection pins that measured a read-only default grid now declare `userActions: { editInline: false }` on their fixture. The editable grid's token is pinned once in the harness 12292 block. Files: `allDeniedSelect-10275`, `calendarDateWindow-12081`, `deadlineSettledSelect-11815`, `dependsOnSelect-13214`, `groupingProjection-7179`, `harvestInputsFetchKey-10689`, `mapLocationSelect-10370`, `referenceViaSelect-13036`, `rowColorSelect-12376`, `timelineMetaFieldsRetired-10222`, and the harness `draftOnlyColumn-34807` / `nameFieldSelect-13116` blocks. `elementDataSource` instead expects `updated_at`: it pins the page-component binding on its default path.

## Acceptance notes

- **Hosts.** Every `ListView` grid opts in, through `ListView` itself (What changes, "Which grids select first"). Every grid no `ListView` draws keeps today's behaviour. The scope (as built, the object list page only, or every grid) is on the maintainer's decision card; this PR is not queued before the answer.
- **Master-detail react pages.** Pages that hand `ListView` an `onRowClick` to open a detail or edit pane (the showcase Task Desk, CRM workbench and renewals pipeline, and the console's SDUI workbench preview) now open it from the title link, Space on a selected cell, or a touch tap. A mouse click on another cell selects it. This is the ruled click model applied to those hosts, and it is part of the scope question. The Task Desk text and its checklist step follow in #35794.
- **Edit column, interim.** On a `ListView` grid (the select-first model), the trailing edit-only column (the pencil header, a changed row's Cancel and Save, its filler cell) is drawn only while a row has pending changes. At rest the list ends on its last data column, as #35554 rules. A commit draws the column with that row's Cancel and Save, and the last save or cancel removes it, so the table is one column wider while a row has changes. Every grid with no `ListView`, and a column that also carries a declared row menu, draws it as before. #35685 retires the column.
- **⌘ / Ctrl / middle click on a data cell** now selects it and opens no new tab, under "clicking any data cell never opens the record". The name link keeps the browser's new-tab gesture (its href, default not prevented).
- **Approval lock window.** The lock is read when a cell of the row is first selected, and needed at the double-click's second press, so on the main edit gesture the read has one double-click interval to answer. When it is slower, the editor opens on a locked record and only the save is refused (the server's `beforeUpdate` hook). The row's `approval_status` column stands in only where the view fetches it: a view with authored columns fetches it only when a column, a row predicate or a grouping names it, so most saved views have no stand-in. The record-level permission verdict has the same window, since the list asks for verdicts on the first selected cell. No write lands. Holding the editor until the answer, and a batched lock read, are #35795.
- **Master-detail children of a locked record** read their own lock, which is unlocked, so they stay editable in a child list. Locking them together is #35599's server half.
- **`ViewSettingsPopover.tsx` was not edited** (#35646 merged before this branch). `showInlineEdit` / `inlineEdit` / `setInlineEdit` and the `toolbar-inline-edit-toggle` row are dead there now, because `ListView` stops passing them. The card for their removal with the two pack keys, #35749, was closed as not planned by triage, so they stay dormant.
- **Dormant leftovers.** `ListPersonalizationPart` keeps its `'inlineEdit'` member, so the exported type does not narrow; nothing produces it now. `ListViewProps.onInlineEditChange` is deprecated.
- **The IME guard is table-wide.** It applies to every `data-table` editor, not only the list page's. `FieldEditWidget` (the record page) is untouched. Field widgets that read Enter themselves (Tags, Lookup, People) still act on an Enter pressed during a composition; that pre-existing gap is #35797.
- **Checklist.** `records-forms.json`'s list-view item is left alone, because #35706 (merged as 598a34d0) bumped that item to the same revision. A different item, `records-forms.v18-semantic-defaults`, still names the removed switch; it is re-pointed in #35794, with `records-forms.form-view-gallery` steps[4].
- **Overlap.** #35706 merged (598a34d0) and was merged into this branch at cf0941e2, keeping both sides. `overlap-check` before the last push (against main 92ab0564): clean. main has moved on since; of its new commits #35744 touches `ListView.tsx` and its harness test, and `overlap-check` reads it as merging cleanly. CI tests the merge ref.
- **Browser coverage, and #35687.** Safari / WebKit is NOT MEASURED, because no WebKit build is installed here. Safari's post-composition 229 Enter is pinned in jsdom only. So this PR says `Part of #35687`: the card stays open for the Safari pinyin check alone.

## Verification

Browser, before (main 238661f4) and after (head 79006b0c), Chromium at 1600 wide in zh-CN, own showcase backend: 21/21 scenarios pass on 79006b0c. The commits since then are the merges with main, the restored pack key, the CapsLock copy fix (pinned in jsdom, with an ablation), a zh-Hant regeneration, the edit column at rest and the grant reader (b6ae2937, fb141148). The last two were checked by the #35554 e2e spec on its own bundle and by jsdom pins, not by the showcase journey. So `after-*` screenshots may show an empty trailing column at rest, which is now gone on the list page, and with #35706 merged `after-01` shows an Options More level that is gone too. Screenshots `before-01…05` and `after-01…21` and `journey.log` are in the seat's evidence folder `build-seat1/35684/`.

<details><summary>Browser journey (summary)</summary>

- Before: the inline-edit switch is in Options → More; a click on a data cell opens the record; with the mode on, a click edits and focus stays on the cell. A real composition (`imeSetComposition('zhong')`, then the IME's Enter with keyCode 229 and `isComposing: true`, then `insertText('中')`) **commits "zhong" early**: the editor closes and the save bar shows 1 change.
- After: no toggle anywhere, including after a reload. A click selects; a double-click edits, caret at the end, Esc restores. Enter and F2 edit. **The same composition leaves 中 in the editor, still editing.** Typing replaces; Enter commits and moves down; Tab moves right. Space and the name link open the record. A calculated total says 「此值由计算得出，不能编辑。」. An approval-locked report (EXP-DEMO, lock read true) says 「此记录正在审批中，已锁定。」. A number takes `5`, and Esc gives back 7. A boolean flips on its second click and again on Space. Paste commits `12`. Backspace on a required amount opens an empty editor and sends no write. A lookup's link navigates, its blank area selects, and a double-click there opens the picker. A textarea takes Enter as a newline and Ctrl+Enter commits. `editInline: false` says 「此视图已关闭列表内编辑。」. A contributor on a project budget gets 「您没有编辑此字段的权限。」. A touch tap opens the record.

</details>
